name: phil/analytics-bundle
description: Privacy-first analytics for Symfony: aggregate counters per UTC day and declared dimension, no visitor identifier, small-number suppression, Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control respected, goals, events, outbound links, shared views, reports and alerts; a collection endpoint, counters in Doctrine DBAL, a daily salt, a rate limit and retention

suggest.doctrine/dbal: To keep the counters in two tables of a Doctrine connection, the default store
suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the counter tables to the schema the ORM generates
suggest.phil/broken-flow-alerts: To be told when a goal stops being reached, under phil_analytics.broken_flows
suggest.symfony/lock: To make the first claim of the daily salt atomic between servers
suggest.symfony/messenger: To run the retention, the reports and the flow check as messages
suggest.symfony/notifier: To send the broken-flow alerts as notifications
suggest.symfony/routing: To import the collection endpoint's route
suggest.symfony/scheduler: To run the daily jobs on the schedule phil_analytics
